action: re-emit provenance-manifest.json corpus block over the post-repair corpus
reason: the convert-time repair (corpus-repair-record.json) dropped one empty-user_turn row after the builder's manifest emission, leaving the manifest's corpus.sha256 pointing at a file that no longer exists (preserved as the .bak). The T-182 full harness hard-checks manifest corpus sha vs the on-disk corpus and would flag the gate report as 'evidence files were altered' — permanently blocking a clean gate report. The manifest must describe the corpus as it exists (the design's content_hash_scope names re-emissions of the same corpus as a stable concept).
unchanged: every other key byte-meaning identical (style_spec, held_out, license_registry, classification/consent checks, ship_mix_assertion, ship_mix_eligible)
verification: eval_golden.provenance_evidence() on the re-emitted manifest: status=verified, content_hash recomputes; corpus pairing: manifest corpus.sha256 == on-disk == trained corpus sha (ec2eee2f...)
provenance: origin of change: the run operator (T-183 Phase B coordinator), recorded here and in the run notes
